The successful candidate may be required to work at different store locations operated by the company, depending on business needs. This role is responsible for managing all aspects of store operations, driving sales performance, leading a team of retail staff, maintaining high customer service standards, and ensuring the store operates efficiently and profitably while complying with company policies and relevant legislation. 
Key Responsibilities
•	Manage the day-to-day operations of the retail store to ensure efficient, safe and profitable business performance.
•	Develop and implement strategies to maximise sales, profitability and customer satisfaction.
•	Monitor store performance, analyse sales results and prepare reports for senior management.
•	Manage inventory levels, coordinate purchasing, oversee stock ordering, receiving and stock control to minimise losses and ensure product availability.
•	Monitor and control operating expenses, cash handling procedures, banking and daily reconciliations.
•	Recruit, train, supervise, mentor and performance manage retail staff.
•	Prepare staff rosters and manage labour resources to ensure efficient store operations.
•	Ensure outstanding customer service standards are consistently maintained and resolve customer enquiries and complaints professionally.
•	Plan and implement merchandising activities, promotional displays and marketing initiatives in accordance with company standards.
•	Ensure compliance with workplace health and safety requirements, food safety regulations, licensing requirements and company policies.
•	Maintain a clean, organised and safe store environment.
•	Liaise with suppliers, service providers and senior management regarding stock, operational requirements and business improvements.
•	Implement loss prevention strategies and maintain effective security and inventory control procedures.
Skills and Experience
•	At least 1 year experience in a retail management or supervisory position, preferably within a convenience store, supermarket or similar retail environment.
•	Demonstrated ability to manage daily retail operations and lead a high-performing team.
•	Experience in inventory management, purchasing, merchandising and stock control.
•	Strong leadership, communication and interpersonal skills.
•	Excellent customer service and conflict resolution abilities.
•	Strong organisational, financial and problem-solving skills.
•	Experience with cash handling, banking procedures and sales reporting.
•	Ability to work flexible hours, including weekends, evenings and public holidays.
•	A proactive, reliable and results-driven approach to retail management.
What We Offer
•	Full-time, permanent employment.
•	Annual salary of $85,000 plus superannuation.
•	Supportive and professional working environment.
•	Opportunities for career development and progression.
•	Ongoing training and professional development.
